55	def compute_scores(df, model, tokenizer, batch_size=16):
56	    texts = df["text"].tolist()
57	    log_lls = np.zeros(len(texts), dtype=np.float64)
58	    fdg_scores = np.zeros(len(texts), dtype=np.float64)
59	
60	    t0 = time.time()
61	    for i in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
62	        batch = texts[i:i + batch_size]
63	        enc = tokenizer(batch, return_tensors="pt", padding=True,
64	                        truncation=True, max_length=512)
65	        input_ids = enc["input_ids"].to(DEVICE)
66	        attn_mask = enc["attention_mask"].to(DEVICE)
67	
68	        logits = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask).logits
69	
70	        for j in range(len(batch)):
71	            mask = attn_mask[j].bool()
72	            ids = input_ids[j][mask]
73	            lgt = logits[j][mask]
74	
75	            if len(ids) < 2:
76	                continue
77	
78	            shift_logits = lgt[:-1].float()
79	            shift_labels = ids[1:]
80	
81	            log_probs = torch.log_softmax(shift_logits, dim=-1)
82	            probs = torch.softmax(shift_logits, dim=-1)
83	
84	            obs = log_probs.gather(1, shift_labels.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)
85	            log_lls[i + j] = obs.mean().item()
86	
87	            # FastDetectGPT: conditional probability curvature (perturbation-free)
88	            # mu_t = E_{X~p(·|ctx)}[log p(X|ctx)] = sum_v p(v) log p(v)
89	            mu = (probs * log_probs).sum(dim=-1)
90	            # var_t = E[log^2 p] - mu^2
91	            var = (probs * log_probs ** 2).sum(dim=-1) - mu ** 2
92	            sigma = torch.sqrt(var.clamp(min=1e-10))
93	            z = (obs - mu) / sigma
94	            fdg_scores[i + j] = z.mean().item()
95	
96	        done = min(i + batch_size, len(texts))
97	        if done % (batch_size * 50) == 0 or done == len(texts):
98	            elapsed = time.time() - t0
99	            rate = done / elapsed if elapsed > 0 else 0
100	            print(f"  {done}/{len(texts)}  ({elapsed:.0f}s, {rate:.0f} texts/s)")
101	
102	    df = df.copy()
103	    df["log_likelihood"] = log_lls
104	    df["fast_detect_gpt"] = fdg_scores
105	    return df

123	def bootstrap_f1(yt, yp, n_boot=N_BOOT, seed=SEED):
124	    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
125	    n = len(yt)
126	    vals = [v for _ in range(n_boot)
127	            if not np.isnan(v := _safe_macro_f1(yt[(idx := rng.randint(0, n, n))], yp[idx]))]
128	    arr = np.array(vals)
129	    return float(np.mean(arr)), float(np.percentile(arr, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(arr, 97.5))

132	def bootstrap_corr(x, y, n_boot=N_BOOT, seed=SEED):
133	    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
134	    n = len(x)
135	    vals = []
136	    for _ in range(n_boot):
137	        idx = rng.randint(0, n, size=n)
138	        rho, _ = spearmanr(x[idx], y[idx])
139	        if not np.isnan(rho):
140	            vals.append(rho)
141	    arr = np.array(vals)
142	    return float(np.mean(arr)), float(np.percentile(arr, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(arr, 97.5))

145	def eval_5fold(df, feature):
146	    X = df[[feature]].values
147	    y = df["label"].values
148	    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
149	    yt_all, yp_all = [], []
150	
151	    for fold, (tr, te) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
152	        tr_ds = downsample(df.iloc[tr], np.random.RandomState(SEED + fold))
153	        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
154	        clf.fit(tr_ds[[feature]].values, tr_ds["label"].values)
155	        yp_all.append(clf.predict(X[te]))
156	        yt_all.append(y[te])
157	
158	    yt = np.concatenate(yt_all)
159	    yp = np.concatenate(yp_all)
160	    macro_f1 = f1_score(yt, yp, average="macro")
161	    per_cls = f1_score(yt, yp, average=None, labels=[0, 1, 2])
162	    _, f1_lo, f1_hi = bootstrap_f1(yt, yp)
163	
164	    rho, pval = spearmanr(df[feature].values, df["depth"].values)
165	    _, rho_lo, rho_hi = bootstrap_corr(df[feature].values, df["depth"].values)
166

49	    ci_lower = float(np.percentile(diffs, 100 * alpha / 2))
50	    ci_upper = float(np.percentile(diffs, 100 * (1 - alpha / 2)))
51	    p_value = float(min(np.mean(diffs <= 0), np.mean(diffs >= 0)) * 2)
52	    return float(np.mean(diffs)), ci_lower, ci_upper, p_value

29	def logo_predictions(df, features, xgb_params):
30	    y_true = np.full(len(df), -1, dtype=int)
31	    y_pred = np.full(len(df), -1, dtype=int)
32	    models = df["model_name"].values
33	    y = df["label"].values
34	    X = df[features].values if isinstance(features, list) else df[[features]].values
35	    for hold in MODELS:
36	        tr = models != hold
37	        te = models == hold
38	        clf = XGBClassifier(**xgb_params)
39	        clf.fit(X[tr], y[tr])
40	        pred = clf.predict(X[te])
41	        y_true[te] = y[te]
42	        y_pred[te] = pred
43	    assert (y_true >= 0).all()
44	    return y_true, y_pred

46	def bootstrap_f1(y_true, y_pred, n_boot=N_BOOT, seed=SEED):
47	    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
48	    n = len(y_true)
49	    scores = []
50	    for _ in range(n_boot):
51	        idx = rng.randint(0, n, size=n)
52	        yt, yp = y_true[idx], y_pred[idx]
53	        if len(np.unique(yt)) < 3:
54	            continue
55	        scores.append(f1_score(yt, yp, average="macro"))
56	    arr = np.array(scores)
57	    return {"mean": float(np.mean(arr)),
58	            "ci_lo": float(np.percentile(arr, 2.5)),
59	            "ci_hi": float(np.percentile(arr, 97.5)),
60	            "n_valid": len(arr)}
61	
62	def paired_bootstrap_test(y_true, y_pred_a, y_pred_b, n_boot=N_BOOT, seed=SEED):
63	    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
64	    n = len(y_true)
65	    diffs = []
66	    for _ in range(n_boot):
67	        idx = rng.randint(0, n, size=n)
68	        yt = y_true[idx]
69	        if len(np.unique(yt)) < 3:
70	            continue
71	        f1_a = f1_score(yt, y_pred_a[idx], average="macro")
72	        f1_b = f1_score(yt, y_pred_b[idx], average="macro")
73	        diffs.append(f1_a - f1_b)
74	    arr = np.array(diffs)
75	    p_value = float(np.mean(arr <= 0))
76	    return {"mean_diff": float(np.mean(arr)),
77	            "ci_lo": float(np.percentile(arr, 2.5)),
78	            "ci_hi": float(np.percentile(arr, 97.5)),
79	            "p_value": p_value,
80	            "n_valid": len(arr)}

99	
100	    print("Running LOGO for avg_logprob...")
101	    yt_lp, yp_lp = logo_predictions(df, "log_likelihood", xgb_single)

65	        input_ids = enc["input_ids"].to(DEVICE)
66	        attn_mask = enc["attention_mask"].to(DEVICE)
67	
68	        logits = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask).logits
69	
70	        for j in range(len(batch)):
71	            mask = attn_mask[j].bool()
72	            ids = input_ids[j][mask]
73	            lgt = logits[j][mask]
74	
75	            if len(ids) < 2:
76	                continue
77	
78	            shift_logits = lgt[:-1].float()
79	            shift_labels = ids[1:]
80	
81	            log_probs = torch.log_softmax(shift_logits, dim=-1)
82	            probs = torch.softmax(shift_logits, dim=-1)

85	            log_lls[i + j] = obs.mean().item()

87	            # FastDetectGPT: conditional probability curvature (perturbation-free)

"""
detector_baseline.py — plan-015
Test whether existing detector scores provide ordinal depth signal.
Detectors: log-likelihood, FastDetectGPT (perturbation-free), entropy_mean
"""

import json, os, time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

SEED = 42
N_BOOT = 1000
DEVICE = "cuda:2"
MODEL_PATH = "/root/autodl-tmp/models/pythia-410m/models--EleutherAI--pythia-410m/snapshots/9879c9b5f8bea9051dcb0e68dff21493d67e9d4f/"
DATA_DIR = "/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data"

CLASS_MAP = {0: 0, 1: 1, 2: 2, 3: 2, 4: 2}
CLASS_NAMES = ["gen-0", "gen-1", "gen-2+"]
XGB_PARAMS = dict(n_estimators=200, max_depth=6, learning_rate=0.1,
                  random_state=SEED, eval_metric="mlogloss",
                  use_label_encoder=False)

GENERATION_FILES = {
    "pythia-2.8b": f"{DATA_DIR}/generations.jsonl",
    "pythia-1b": f"{DATA_DIR}/pythia-1b/generations.jsonl",
    "olmo-2-1b": f"{DATA_DIR}/olmo-2-1b/generations.jsonl",
    "qwen3-0.6b": f"{DATA_DIR}/qwen3-0.6b/generations.jsonl",
    "qwen3-1.7b": f"{DATA_DIR}/qwen3-1.7b/generations.jsonl",
}


def load_all_texts():
    rows = []
    for model_name, path in GENERATION_FILES.items():
        with open(path) as f:
            for line in f:
                obj = json.loads(line)
                rows.append({
                    "model_name": model_name,
                    "seed_id": obj["seed_id"],
                    "depth": obj["depth"],
                    "text": obj["text"],
                })
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    df["label"] = df["depth"].map(CLASS_MAP)
    return df


@torch.no_grad()
def compute_scores(df, model, tokenizer, batch_size=16):
    texts = df["text"].tolist()
    log_lls = np.zeros(len(texts), dtype=np.float64)
    fdg_scores = np.zeros(len(texts), dtype=np.float64)

    t0 = time.time()
    for i in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
        batch = texts[i:i + batch_size]
        enc = tokenizer(batch, return_tensors="pt", padding=True,
                        truncation=True, max_length=512)
        input_ids = enc["input_ids"].to(DEVICE)
        attn_mask = enc["attention_mask"].to(DEVICE)

        logits = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask).logits

        for j in range(len(batch)):
            mask = attn_mask[j].bool()
            ids = input_ids[j][mask]
            lgt = logits[j][mask]

            if len(ids) < 2:
                continue

            shift_logits = lgt[:-1].float()
            shift_labels = ids[1:]

            log_probs = torch.log_softmax(shift_logits, dim=-1)
            probs = torch.softmax(shift_logits, dim=-1)

            obs = log_probs.gather(1, shift_labels.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)
            log_lls[i + j] = obs.mean().item()

            # FastDetectGPT: conditional probability curvature (perturbation-free)
            # mu_t = E_{X~p(·|ctx)}[log p(X|ctx)] = sum_v p(v) log p(v)
            mu = (probs * log_probs).sum(dim=-1)
            # var_t = E[log^2 p] - mu^2
            var = (probs * log_probs ** 2).sum(dim=-1) - mu ** 2
            sigma = torch.sqrt(var.clamp(min=1e-10))
            z = (obs - mu) / sigma
            fdg_scores[i + j] = z.mean().item()

        done = min(i + batch_size, len(texts))
        if done % (batch_size * 50) == 0 or done == len(texts):
            elapsed = time.time() - t0
            rate = done / elapsed if elapsed > 0 else 0
            print(f"  {done}/{len(texts)}  ({elapsed:.0f}s, {rate:.0f} texts/s)")

    df = df.copy()
    df["log_likelihood"] = log_lls
    df["fast_detect_gpt"] = fdg_scores
    return df


# ─── Evaluation helpers ───

def downsample(df, rng):
    min_n = df["label"].value_counts().min()
    parts = [df[df["label"] == lbl].sample(n=min_n, random_state=rng, replace=False)
             for lbl in sorted(df["label"].unique())]
    return pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)


def _safe_macro_f1(yt, yp):
    if len(np.unique(yt)) < 3:
        return np.nan
    return f1_score(yt, yp, average="macro")


def bootstrap_f1(yt, yp, n_boot=N_BOOT, seed=SEED):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n = len(yt)
    vals = [v for _ in range(n_boot)
            if not np.isnan(v := _safe_macro_f1(yt[(idx := rng.randint(0, n, n))], yp[idx]))]
    arr = np.array(vals)
    return float(np.mean(arr)), float(np.percentile(arr, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(arr, 97.5))


def bootstrap_corr(x, y, n_boot=N_BOOT, seed=SEED):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n = len(x)
    vals = []
    for _ in range(n_boot):
        idx = rng.randint(0, n, size=n)
        rho, _ = spearmanr(x[idx], y[idx])
        if not np.isnan(rho):
            vals.append(rho)
    arr = np.array(vals)
    return float(np.mean(arr)), float(np.percentile(arr, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(arr, 97.5))


def eval_5fold(df, feature):
    X = df[[feature]].values
    y = df["label"].values
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    yt_all, yp_all = [], []

    for fold, (tr, te) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
        tr_ds = downsample(df.iloc[tr], np.random.RandomState(SEED + fold))
        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(tr_ds[[feature]].values, tr_ds["label"].values)
        yp_all.append(clf.predict(X[te]))
        yt_all.append(y[te])

    yt = np.concatenate(yt_all)
    yp = np.concatenate(yp_all)
    macro_f1 = f1_score(yt, yp, average="macro")
    per_cls = f1_score(yt, yp, average=None, labels=[0, 1, 2])
    _, f1_lo, f1_hi = bootstrap_f1(yt, yp)

    rho, pval = spearmanr(df[feature].values, df["depth"].values)
    _, rho_lo, rho_hi = bootstrap_corr(df[feature].values, df["depth"].values)

    return {
        "5fold_macro_f1": round(macro_f1, 4),
        "5fold_f1_ci": [round(f1_lo, 4), round(f1_hi, 4)],
        "gen-0_f1": round(float(per_cls[0]), 4),
        "gen-1_f1": round(float(per_cls[1]), 4),
        "gen-2+_f1": round(float(per_cls[2]), 4),
        "spearman_rho": round(float(rho), 4),
        "spearman_p": float(pval),
        "spearman_ci": [round(rho_lo, 4), round(rho_hi, 4)],
    }


def eval_logo(df, feature):
    generators = sorted(df["model_name"].unique())
    yt_all, yp_all = [], []
    per_gen = {}

    for gen in generators:
        te = df[df["model_name"] == gen]
        tr = downsample(df[df["model_name"] != gen], np.random.RandomState(SEED))
        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(tr[[feature]].values, tr["label"].values)
        yp = clf.predict(te[[feature]].values)
        per_gen[gen] = round(float(f1_score(te["label"].values, yp, average="macro")), 4)
        yt_all.append(te["label"].values)
        yp_all.append(yp)

    yt = np.concatenate(yt_all)
    yp = np.concatenate(yp_all)
    macro_f1 = f1_score(yt, yp, average="macro")
    per_cls = f1_score(yt, yp, average=None, labels=[0, 1, 2])
    _, f1_lo, f1_hi = bootstrap_f1(yt, yp)

    return {
        "logo_macro_f1": round(macro_f1, 4),
        "logo_f1_ci": [round(f1_lo, 4), round(f1_hi, 4)],
        "logo_gen-0_f1": round(float(per_cls[0]), 4),
        "logo_gen-1_f1": round(float(per_cls[1]), 4),
        "logo_gen-2+_f1": round(float(per_cls[2]), 4),
        "per_generator": per_gen,
    }


def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("Plan-015: Detector Baseline Evaluation")
    print("=" * 60)

    # --- Load model ---
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM
    print("\nLoading Pythia-410M...")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_PATH)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(MODEL_PATH, torch_dtype=torch.float16)
    model.to(DEVICE).eval()
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token
    print(f"Model on {DEVICE}")

    # --- Load texts ---
    print("\nLoading texts...")
    df = load_all_texts()
    print(f"Total: {len(df)}  Labels: {df['label'].value_counts().sort_index().to_dict()}")

    # --- Compute scores ---
    print("\nComputing log-likelihood & FastDetectGPT scores...")
    df = compute_scores(df, model, tokenizer, batch_size=16)
    del model
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    # --- Merge entropy_mean ---
    print("\nMerging entropy_mean from features_all_models.csv...")
    feat_df = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/features_all_models.csv")
    df = df.merge(feat_df[["model_name", "seed_id", "depth", "entropy_mean"]],
                  on=["model_name", "seed_id", "depth"], how="left")

    # Save intermediate scores
    score_cols = ["model_name", "seed_id", "depth", "label",
                  "log_likelihood", "fast_detect_gpt", "entropy_mean"]
    df[score_cols].to_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/detector_scores.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved detector scores → {DATA_DIR}/detector_scores.csv")

    # --- Evaluate ---
    detectors = ["log_likelihood", "fast_detect_gpt", "entropy_mean"]
    results = {}

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("5-Fold Stratified CV (1:1:1 downsampled)")
    print("=" * 60)
    for det in detectors:
        r = eval_5fold(df, det)
        results[det] = r
        print(f"\n  {det}:")
        print(f"    macro-F1 = {r['5fold_macro_f1']:.4f}  "
              f"[{r['5fold_f1_ci'][0]:.4f}, {r['5fold_f1_ci'][1]:.4f}]")
        print(f"    per-class: g0={r['gen-0_f1']:.4f}  g1={r['gen-1_f1']:.4f}  "
              f"g2+={r['gen-2+_f1']:.4f}")
        print(f"    Spearman ρ = {r['spearman_rho']:.4f}  "
              f"[{r['spearman_ci'][0]:.4f}, {r['spearman_ci'][1]:.4f}]")

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("LOGO (Leave-One-Generator-Out)")
    print("=" * 60)
    for det in detectors:
        r = eval_logo(df, det)
        results[det].update(r)
        print(f"\n  {det}:")
        print(f"    LOGO macro-F1 = {r['logo_macro_f1']:.4f}  "
              f"[{r['logo_f1_ci'][0]:.4f}, {r['logo_f1_ci'][1]:.4f}]")
        print(f"    per-gen: {r['per_generator']}")

    # Reference
    results["7_feature_model_reference"] = {
        "logo_macro_f1": 0.8037,
        "note": "plan-002-eval LOGO, 7 features, XGBoost"
    }
    results["skipped_detectors"] = {
        "ld_score": "arXiv:2605.01647 — no public implementation; "
                    "character-distribution method not trivially reproducible",
        "binoculars": "requires two models (observer+performer); "
                      "skipped to conserve GPU memory on shared device"
    }

    # --- Comparison table ---
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("COMPARISON TABLE")
    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"{'Detector':<20s} {'5fold-F1':>9s} {'LOGO-F1':>9s} "
          f"{'Spearman':>9s} {'ρ 95% CI':>20s}")
    print("-" * 70)
    for det in detectors:
        r = results[det]
        print(f"{det:<20s} {r['5fold_macro_f1']:>9.4f} {r['logo_macro_f1']:>9.4f} "
              f"{r['spearman_rho']:>9.4f} "
              f"[{r['spearman_ci'][0]:.4f}, {r['spearman_ci'][1]:.4f}]")
    print(f"{'7-feature (ref)':<20s} {'—':>9s} {'0.8037':>9s} {'—':>9s}")

    # --- Save ---
    out_path = f"{DATA_DIR}/detector_baseline_results.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    print(f"\nSaved: {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

214	def compute_reference_features(texts, tokenizer, model, device, batch_size=8):
215	    results = []
216	    for start in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
217	        batch_texts = texts[start:start + batch_size]
218	        encodings = tokenizer(
219	            batch_texts, return_tensors="pt", padding=True,
220	            truncation=True, max_length=512,
221	        ).to(device)
222	
223	        with torch.no_grad():
224	            logits = model(**encodings).logits
225	
226	        for i in range(len(batch_texts)):
227	            mask = encodings["attention_mask"][i].bool()
228	            seq_len = mask.sum().item()
229	            if seq_len < 2:
230	                results.append({k: 0.0 for k in
231	                    ["entropy_mean", "entropy_std", "entropy_min", "entropy_max", "tail_decay"]})
232	                continue
233	
234	            token_logits = logits[i, :seq_len - 1, :]
235	            log_probs = torch.log_softmax(token_logits, dim=-1)
236	            probs = torch.exp(log_probs)
237	            entropy = -(probs * log_probs).sum(dim=-1)
238	            entropy_np = entropy.float().cpu().numpy()
239	
240	            avg_log_probs = log_probs.float().mean(dim=0)
241	            sorted_lp, _ = torch.sort(avg_log_probs, descending=True)
242	            sorted_lp_np = sorted_lp.cpu().numpy()
243	
244	            vocab_size = sorted_lp_np.shape[0]
245	            hi = min(1000, vocab_size)
246	            lo = min(100, hi)
247	            if hi - lo >= 2:
248	                x = np.arange(lo, hi, dtype=np.float64)
249	                y = sorted_lp_np[lo:hi].astype(np.float64)
250	                coeffs = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
251	                tail_decay = float(coeffs[0])
252	            else:
253	                tail_decay = 0.0
254	
255	            results.append({
256	                "entropy_mean": float(np.mean(entropy_np)),
257	                "entropy_std": float(np.std(entropy_np)),
258	                "entropy_min": float(np.min(entropy_np)),
259	                "entropy_max": float(np.max(entropy_np)),
260	                "tail_decay": tail_decay,
261	            })
262	
263	        done = min(start + batch_size, len(texts))
264	        if done % (batch_size * 20) == 0 or done == len(texts):
265	            print(f"    ref features: [{done}/{len(texts)}]")
266	
267	    return results
268

273	        words = text.lower().split()
274	        n = len(words)
275	        if n == 0:
276	            results.append({"ttr": 0.0, "hapax_ratio": 0.0})
277	            continue
278	        counter = Counter(words)
279	        results.append({
280	            "ttr": len(counter) / n,
281	            "hapax_ratio": sum(1 for c in counter.values() if c == 1) / n,
282	        })
283	    return results

366	def downsample(df, rng):
367	    min_n = df["label"].value_counts().min()
368	    parts = [df[df["label"] == lbl].sample(n=min_n, random_state=rng, replace=False)

373	def run_logo(df, features=FEATURES):
374	    generators = sorted(df["model_name"].unique())
375	    yt_all, yp_all = [], []
376	    per_gen = {}

381	        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)

383	        yp = clf.predict(te[features].values)
384	        per_gen[gen] = round(float(f1_score(te["label"].values, yp, average="macro")), 4)
385	        yt_all.append(te["label"].values)

392	
393	    # Binary F1: gen-1 vs gen-2+ (exclude gen-0)
394	    mask = yt > 0

397	        binary_yp = (yp[mask] > 1).astype(int)
398	        binary_f1 = f1_score(binary_yt, binary_yp, average="binary")
399	    else:
400	        binary_f1 = 0.0
401	
402	    return {
403	        "3class_f1": round(float(macro_f1), 4),
404	        "binary_f1": round(float(binary_f1), 4),
405	        "per_class_f1": {

"""
sampling_ablation.py — Sampling Strategy Ablation for Depth Signal Robustness

Tests whether depth signal is robust across different sampling configurations:
  low:     temperature=0.5, top_p=0.8
  default: temperature=0.7, top_p=0.9  (existing data, skip generation)
  high:    temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95

Pipeline: generate chains -> extract features -> LOGO evaluation
Output:   results/sampling_ablation.json
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import time
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from tqdm import tqdm
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score

import signal
signal.signal(signal.SIGHUP, signal.SIG_IGN)

SEED = 42
GENERATOR_MODEL = "/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen/Qwen3-1___7B-Base"
REFERENCE_MODEL = "/root/autodl-tmp/models/pythia-410m/models--EleutherAI--pythia-410m/snapshots/9879c9b5f8bea9051dcb0e68dff21493d67e9d4f"
DATA_DIR = Path("/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data")
RESULTS_DIR = Path("/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results")
SEED_FILE = DATA_DIR / "wiki_seed_1000.jsonl"

CONFIGS = {
    "low_t05_p08":     {"temperature": 0.5, "top_p": 0.8,  "dir": "qwen3-1.7b-low-temp"},
    "default_t07_p09": {"temperature": 0.7, "top_p": 0.9,  "dir": "qwen3-1.7b"},
    "high_t10_p095":   {"temperature": 1.0, "top_p": 0.95, "dir": "qwen3-1.7b-high-temp"},
}

FEATURES = ["entropy_mean", "entropy_std", "entropy_min", "entropy_max",
            "tail_decay", "ttr", "hapax_ratio"]
CLASS_MAP = {0: 0, 1: 1, 2: 2, 3: 2, 4: 2}
XGB_PARAMS = dict(n_estimators=200, max_depth=6, learning_rate=0.1,
                  random_state=SEED, eval_metric="mlogloss",
                  use_label_encoder=False)
MAX_DEPTH = 4
NUM_DEPTHS = MAX_DEPTH + 1


# ================================================================
# Phase 1: Generation
# ================================================================

def load_seeds(path, tokenizer, max_tokens=256):
    seeds = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line_num, line in enumerate(f):
            item = json.loads(line)
            text = item.get("text", "")
            if len(text.strip()) < 100:
                continue
            token_ids = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)[:max_tokens]
            if len(token_ids) < 64:
                continue
            seeds.append({"seed_id": line_num, "text": tokenizer.decode(token_ids)})
    return seeds


def generate_continuation(model, tokenizer, text, device,
                          max_new_tokens=256, prompt_tokens=128,
                          temperature=0.7, top_p=0.9):
    input_ids = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
    if len(input_ids) == 0:
        return ""
    input_ids = input_ids[-prompt_tokens:]
    input_tensor = torch.tensor([input_ids], device=device)

    with torch.no_grad():
        output = model.generate(
            input_tensor,
            max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
            temperature=temperature,
            top_p=top_p,
            do_sample=True,
            pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id,
        )

    new_tokens = output[0][len(input_ids):]
    return tokenizer.decode(new_tokens, skip_special_tokens=True)


def load_done_seeds(path):
    done = set()
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return done
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                done.add(json.loads(line)["seed_id"])
            except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError):
                pass
    return done


def run_generation(config_name, config, seeds, gen_model, gen_tokenizer, device):
    output_dir = DATA_DIR / config["dir"]
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output_path = output_dir / "generations_shard0.jsonl"

    done_seeds = load_done_seeds(output_path)
    remaining = [s for s in seeds if s["seed_id"] not in done_seeds]

    if not remaining:
        print(f"  [{config_name}] All {len(seeds)} seeds done, skipping")
        return

    print(f"  [{config_name}] {len(done_seeds)} done, {len(remaining)} remaining")

    t0 = time.time()
    record_count = 0

    with open(output_path, "a") as f:
        for i, seed_info in enumerate(tqdm(remaining, desc=config_name)):
            seed_id = seed_info["seed_id"]
            seed_text = seed_info["text"]
            base_id = seed_id * NUM_DEPTHS

            gen0_tokens = gen_tokenizer.encode(seed_text, add_special_tokens=False)
            f.write(json.dumps({
                "id": base_id, "depth": 0, "text": seed_text,
                "seed_id": seed_id, "token_count": len(gen0_tokens),
                "model": "qwen3-1.7b",
            }, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            f.flush()
            record_count += 1

            prev_text = seed_text
            for depth in range(1, NUM_DEPTHS):
                check_ids = gen_tokenizer.encode(prev_text, add_special_tokens=False)
                if len(check_ids) == 0 or len(prev_text.strip()) < 10:
                    print(f"  WARN: seed {seed_id} depth {depth}: empty input, skipping rest")
                    break

                continuation = generate_continuation(
                    gen_model, gen_tokenizer, prev_text, device,
                    temperature=config["temperature"], top_p=config["top_p"],
                )
                if not continuation or len(continuation.strip()) == 0:
                    print(f"  WARN: seed {seed_id} depth {depth}: empty output, skipping rest")
                    break

                cont_tokens = gen_tokenizer.encode(continuation, add_special_tokens=False)
                f.write(json.dumps({
                    "id": base_id + depth, "depth": depth, "text": continuation,
                    "seed_id": seed_id, "token_count": len(cont_tokens),
                    "model": "qwen3-1.7b",
                }, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
                f.flush()
                record_count += 1
                prev_text = continuation

            if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
                elapsed = time.time() - t0
                rate = (i + 1) / elapsed
                print(f"  [{i+1}/{len(remaining)}] {elapsed:.0f}s, {rate:.2f} seeds/s")

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    print(f"  [{config_name}] {record_count} records in {elapsed:.1f}s")


def phase_generate(device):
    print("=" * 60)
    print("PHASE 1: Generation (low + high)")
    print("=" * 60)

    print("Loading Qwen3-1.7B-Base...")
    gen_tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
        GENERATOR_MODEL, trust_remote_code=True)
    gen_model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        GENERATOR_MODEL, dtype=torch.float16, trust_remote_code=True
    ).to(device)
    gen_model.eval()
    if gen_tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        gen_tokenizer.pad_token = gen_tokenizer.eos_token
    print(f"Model on {device}")

    seeds = load_seeds(SEED_FILE, gen_tokenizer)
    print(f"Loaded {len(seeds)} seeds")

    for cfg_name in ["low_t05_p08", "high_t10_p095"]:
        cfg = CONFIGS[cfg_name]
        print(f"\n--- {cfg_name}: T={cfg['temperature']}, p={cfg['top_p']} ---")
        torch.manual_seed(SEED)
        torch.cuda.manual_seed(SEED)
        run_generation(cfg_name, cfg, seeds, gen_model, gen_tokenizer, device)

    del gen_model, gen_tokenizer
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    print("\nGeneration complete\n")


# ================================================================
# Phase 2: Feature Extraction
# ================================================================

def compute_reference_features(texts, tokenizer, model, device, batch_size=8):
    results = []
    for start in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
        batch_texts = texts[start:start + batch_size]
        encodings = tokenizer(
            batch_texts, return_tensors="pt", padding=True,
            truncation=True, max_length=512,
        ).to(device)

        with torch.no_grad():
            logits = model(**encodings).logits

        for i in range(len(batch_texts)):
            mask = encodings["attention_mask"][i].bool()
            seq_len = mask.sum().item()
            if seq_len < 2:
                results.append({k: 0.0 for k in
                    ["entropy_mean", "entropy_std", "entropy_min", "entropy_max", "tail_decay"]})
                continue

            token_logits = logits[i, :seq_len - 1, :]
            log_probs = torch.log_softmax(token_logits, dim=-1)
            probs = torch.exp(log_probs)
            entropy = -(probs * log_probs).sum(dim=-1)
            entropy_np = entropy.float().cpu().numpy()

            avg_log_probs = log_probs.float().mean(dim=0)
            sorted_lp, _ = torch.sort(avg_log_probs, descending=True)
            sorted_lp_np = sorted_lp.cpu().numpy()

            vocab_size = sorted_lp_np.shape[0]
            hi = min(1000, vocab_size)
            lo = min(100, hi)
            if hi - lo >= 2:
                x = np.arange(lo, hi, dtype=np.float64)
                y = sorted_lp_np[lo:hi].astype(np.float64)
                coeffs = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
                tail_decay = float(coeffs[0])
            else:
                tail_decay = 0.0

            results.append({
                "entropy_mean": float(np.mean(entropy_np)),
                "entropy_std": float(np.std(entropy_np)),
                "entropy_min": float(np.min(entropy_np)),
                "entropy_max": float(np.max(entropy_np)),
                "tail_decay": tail_decay,
            })

        done = min(start + batch_size, len(texts))
        if done % (batch_size * 20) == 0 or done == len(texts):
            print(f"    ref features: [{done}/{len(texts)}]")

    return results


def compute_surface_features(texts):
    results = []
    for text in texts:
        words = text.lower().split()
        n = len(words)
        if n == 0:
            results.append({"ttr": 0.0, "hapax_ratio": 0.0})
            continue
        counter = Counter(words)
        results.append({
            "ttr": len(counter) / n,
            "hapax_ratio": sum(1 for c in counter.values() if c == 1) / n,
        })
    return results


def load_generation_records(data_dir):
    records = []
    seen = set()
    paths = sorted(data_dir.glob("generations*.jsonl"))
    for p in paths:
        with open(p) as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if not line:
                    continue
                rec = json.loads(line)
                key = (rec["seed_id"], rec["depth"])
                if key not in seen:
                    seen.add(key)
                    records.append(rec)
    return records


def extract_features_for_config(config_name, config, ref_tokenizer, ref_model, device):
    feat_path = DATA_DIR / f"features_{config['dir']}.csv"

    if feat_path.exists():
        df = pd.read_csv(feat_path)
        print(f"  [{config_name}] Features exist: {feat_path} ({len(df)} rows)")
        return df

    data_dir = DATA_DIR / config["dir"]
    records = load_generation_records(data_dir)
    print(f"  [{config_name}] {len(records)} records loaded")

    texts = [r["text"] for r in records]
    print(f"  [{config_name}] Computing reference features...")
    ref_feats = compute_reference_features(texts, ref_tokenizer, ref_model, device)
    surf_feats = compute_surface_features(texts)

    rows = []
    for rec, ref, surf in zip(records, ref_feats, surf_feats):
        rows.append({
            "model_name": "qwen3-1.7b",
            "seed_id": rec["seed_id"],
            "depth": rec["depth"],
            **ref, **surf,
        })

    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    df.to_csv(feat_path, index=False)
    print(f"  [{config_name}] Saved: {feat_path} ({len(df)} rows)")
    return df


def phase_features(device):
    print("=" * 60)
    print("PHASE 2: Feature Extraction")
    print("=" * 60)

    print("Loading Pythia-410M reference model...")
    ref_tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(REFERENCE_MODEL, local_files_only=True)
    ref_model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        REFERENCE_MODEL, local_files_only=True, torch_dtype=torch.float16
    ).to(device).eval()
    if ref_tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        ref_tokenizer.pad_token = ref_tokenizer.eos_token
    print(f"Reference model on {device}")

    config_features = {}
    for cfg_name, cfg in CONFIGS.items():
        print(f"\n--- {cfg_name} ---")
        config_features[cfg_name] = extract_features_for_config(
            cfg_name, cfg, ref_tokenizer, ref_model, device)

    del ref_model, ref_tokenizer
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    print("\nFeature extraction complete\n")
    return config_features


# ================================================================
# Phase 3: LOGO Evaluation
# ================================================================

def downsample(df, rng):
    min_n = df["label"].value_counts().min()
    parts = [df[df["label"] == lbl].sample(n=min_n, random_state=rng, replace=False)
             for lbl in sorted(df["label"].unique())]
    return pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)


def run_logo(df, features=FEATURES):
    generators = sorted(df["model_name"].unique())
    yt_all, yp_all = [], []
    per_gen = {}

    for gen in generators:
        te = df[df["model_name"] == gen]
        tr = downsample(df[df["model_name"] != gen], np.random.RandomState(SEED))
        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(tr[features].values, tr["label"].values)
        yp = clf.predict(te[features].values)
        per_gen[gen] = round(float(f1_score(te["label"].values, yp, average="macro")), 4)
        yt_all.append(te["label"].values)
        yp_all.append(yp)

    yt = np.concatenate(yt_all)
    yp = np.concatenate(yp_all)
    macro_f1 = f1_score(yt, yp, average="macro")
    per_cls = f1_score(yt, yp, average=None, labels=[0, 1, 2])

    # Binary F1: gen-1 vs gen-2+ (exclude gen-0)
    mask = yt > 0
    if mask.sum() > 0:
        binary_yt = (yt[mask] > 1).astype(int)
        binary_yp = (yp[mask] > 1).astype(int)
        binary_f1 = f1_score(binary_yt, binary_yp, average="binary")
    else:
        binary_f1 = 0.0

    return {
        "3class_f1": round(float(macro_f1), 4),
        "binary_f1": round(float(binary_f1), 4),
        "per_class_f1": {
            "gen-0": round(float(per_cls[0]), 4),
            "gen-1": round(float(per_cls[1]), 4),
            "gen-2+": round(float(per_cls[2]), 4),
        },
        "per_generator": per_gen,
    }


def compute_spearman(df):
    corrs = {}
    for feat in FEATURES:
        rho, _ = spearmanr(df[feat].values, df["depth"].values)
        corrs[f"spearman_{feat}"] = round(float(rho), 4)
    return corrs


def phase_evaluate(config_features):
    print("=" * 60)
    print("PHASE 3: LOGO Evaluation")
    print("=" * 60)

    # Load base features (all generators except qwen3-1.7b)
    base_csv = DATA_DIR / "features_all_models.csv"
    base_df = pd.read_csv(base_csv)
    base_df["label"] = base_df["depth"].map(CLASS_MAP)
    base_no_qwen = base_df[base_df["model_name"] != "qwen3-1.7b"].copy()
    print(f"Base features: {len(base_no_qwen)} rows "
          f"({base_no_qwen['model_name'].nunique()} generators)")

    results = {"configs": {}}

    for cfg_name, cfg in CONFIGS.items():
        print(f"\n--- {cfg_name} ---")

        if cfg_name in config_features:
            cfg_df = config_features[cfg_name].copy()
        else:
            feat_path = DATA_DIR / f"features_{cfg['dir']}.csv"
            cfg_df = pd.read_csv(feat_path)

        cfg_df["label"] = cfg_df["depth"].map(CLASS_MAP)

        # For default config, use existing features from features_all_models.csv
        if cfg_name == "default_t07_p09":
            cfg_df = base_df[base_df["model_name"] == "qwen3-1.7b"].copy()

        combined = pd.concat([base_no_qwen, cfg_df], ignore_index=True)
        print(f"  Combined: {len(combined)} rows, "
              f"generators: {sorted(combined['model_name'].unique())}")

        logo = run_logo(combined)
        spearman = compute_spearman(cfg_df)

        results["configs"][cfg_name] = {**logo, **spearman}

        print(f"  3-class F1: {logo['3class_f1']:.4f}")
        print(f"  Binary F1:  {logo['binary_f1']:.4f}")
        print(f"  Per-gen:    {logo['per_generator']}")

    # Compute summary
    f1_values = [r["3class_f1"] for r in results["configs"].values()]
    f1_range = max(f1_values) - min(f1_values)
    results["f1_range"] = round(f1_range, 4)
    results["f1_range_pp"] = round(f1_range * 100, 2)
    results["robust"] = f1_range < 0.03

    binary_values = [r["binary_f1"] for r in results["configs"].values()]
    results["binary_f1_range"] = round(max(binary_values) - min(binary_values), 4)

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("SUMMARY")
    print("=" * 60)
    print(f"{'Config':<20s} {'3class-F1':>10s} {'Binary-F1':>10s}")
    print("-" * 42)
    for cfg_name, r in results["configs"].items():
        print(f"{cfg_name:<20s} {r['3class_f1']:>10.4f} {r['binary_f1']:>10.4f}")
    print(f"\nF1 range: {results['f1_range_pp']:.2f}pp")
    print(f"Robust: {results['robust']}")

    RESULTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = RESULTS_DIR / "sampling_ablation.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    print(f"\nSaved: {out_path}")

    return results


# ================================================================
# Main
# ================================================================

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cuda:3")
    parser.add_argument("--phase", choices=["all", "generate", "features", "evaluate"],
                        default="all")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    device = torch.device(args.device)
    print(f"Device: {device}")
    print(f"Phase: {args.phase}")
    print()

    config_features = {}

    if args.phase in ("all", "generate"):
        phase_generate(device)

    if args.phase in ("all", "features"):
        config_features = phase_features(device)

    if args.phase in ("all", "evaluate"):
        phase_evaluate(config_features)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

1	\section{Discussion}
2	\label{sec:discussion}
3	
4	\paragraph{Why does shape remain approximately stationary?}
5	The softmax architecture and sampling hyperparameters that determine distributional shape are fixed across depths.
6	Recursive generation shifts context toward high-probability regions, reducing entropy mean, but does not alter the generation mechanism itself.
7	This account predicts approximate stationarity under standard decoding: sampling ablation confirms that shape measures remain stable when sampling noise is low ($t \in [0.5, 0.7]$, ${\leq}0.3$\,pp degradation), but stationarity weakens at $t = 1.0$ ($-6$\,pp; Appendix~\ref{app:sampling-sensitivity}), where sampling randomness begins to dominate the systematic location shift.
8	The phenomenon thus reflects a tendency of standard decoding rather than an architectural guarantee.
9	
10	\paragraph{Prompt-type dependence.}
11	Continuation chains yield the strongest signal (F1\,=\,0.781 vs.\ 0.730 for elaboration), with cross-type transfer at 0.753 (Appendix~\ref{app:prompt-type}).
12	Semantic-preservation constraints attenuate drift, consistent with \citet{broken_telephone}: the more a task anchors the output distribution to the input, the less room recursive drift has to accumulate.
13	
14	\paragraph{Practical applicability.}
15	At the document level, gen-1 per-class F1\,=\,0.63 (37\% misclassification) is insufficient for automated filtering but sufficient for corpus-level flagging, where error scales as $O(1/\sqrt{n})$ and aggregate depth composition estimates become reliable.
16	Error analysis (Appendix~\ref{app:error-analysis}) confirms that misclassifications concentrate in shallow gen-2+ samples where drift has not yet accumulated, consistent with DDR predictions.
17	
18	\paragraph{The gen-1\,/\,gen-2+ boundary.}
19	The primary classification difficulty is distinguishing gen-1 from gen-2+: 86\% of binary errors are false negatives (gen-2+ predicted as gen-1), with depth-2 error rate at 48\% compared to 20\% for depth-4.
20	This asymmetry follows directly from DDR: the first recursive step produces the smallest location shift, so depth-2 text occupies a region of feature space that overlaps heavily with gen-1.
21	Larger generators exacerbate the overlap (Mistral-7B error rate 45\% vs.\ Pythia-1B 18\%), consistent with higher-capacity models producing text that more closely matches the statistical properties of human-sourced input.
22	
23	\paragraph{Relation to model collapse.}
24	Model collapse \cite{curse_of_recursion,strong_model_collapse} describes degradation when models are \emph{retrained} on their own outputs.
25	Our inference-chain drift occurs without parameter updates, potentially representing an early, reversible stage of the same distributional narrowing.
26	Topic drift accounts for $<$9\% of feature variance ($R^2 = 0.082$; OLS with 7 depth features as DV and 20-topic LDA proportions as IVs, pooled across generators), confirming it mediates rather than confounds depth signal.
27	
28	\paragraph{Granularity and robustness.}
29	Three classes represent the practical resolution ceiling: 5-class LOGO F1 drops to $\approx$0.50, with depths 2--4 mutually indistinguishable (Appendix~\ref{app:finer-depth}).
30	That said, QLoRA fine-tuning recovers 3-class F1\,=\,0.905 (Appendix~\ref{app:qlora}), confirming that richer signal exists beyond the seven summary statistics.
31	Under text perturbation, LLM-simulated sentence regeneration (50\% edit distance) causes comparable degradation to 5\% random word replacement (Appendix~\ref{app:human-edit}), confirming that depth signal resides in generative structure rather than surface token statistics.
32	
33	\paragraph{Instruction tuning.}
34	Instruction-tuned models show substantially weaker fingerprints (OLMo-Instruct LOGO F1\,=\,0.338 vs.\ 0.763 base).
35	Length regulation and format constraints imposed by alignment compress the distributional variation that depth fingerprinting exploits, justifying our restriction to base models as the appropriate setting for isolating the phenomenon.

We evaluated two ordinal-specific methods (CORAL \cite{coral_ordinal}, Frank-Hall ordinal ensemble \cite{frank_hall_ordinal}); neither significantly outperforms multiclass XGBoost (CIs overlapping; \S\ref{sec:results}), confirming that with only three ordinal levels, ordinal structure provides minimal additional benefit.

\paragraph{Metrics and statistical testing.}
The primary metric is \textbf{macro-averaged F1} over the three depth classes, which weights minority classes (gen-1, gen-2+) equally against the typically easier gen-0 class.
We report per-class F1 scores and 95\% confidence intervals via \emph{percentile bootstrap} ($n{=}1{,}000$), resampling at the document level within each held-out fold.
For pairwise model comparisons (e.g., full features vs.\ ablated subsets), we use the \textbf{McNemar test} on disagreement tables.
For comparisons against detection baselines, we use \textbf{paired bootstrap} significance tests.
All reported $p$-values are two-sided.
We report four pairwise comparisons (ensemble vs.\ each individual baseline) in \S\ref{sec:results-baselines}; applying Bonferroni correction ($\alpha_{\text{adj}} = 0.05/4 = 0.0125$), all remain significant at $p < 0.001$.
Feature--depth correlations (\S\ref{sec:results-differential}) are computed on class-balanced subsamples (equal samples per depth class) to control for depth-class imbalance in the generation pipeline.

\paragraph{Baselines.}
We compare the 7-feature ensemble against four single-score detection methods repurposed as ordinal depth predictors: Avg-LogProb, FastDetectGPT \cite{fast_detectgpt}, Binoculars \cite{binoculars}, and LD-Score \cite{ld_score}.
Each baseline score is used as a univariate feature in the same XGBoost framework under LOGO cross-validation, ensuring a controlled comparison.

\paragraph{Length confound control.}
Since TTR and hapax\_ratio are mechanically length-dependent, we verify that depth signal is not an artifact of systematic length variation.
We conduct three complementary analyses: (1) length--depth correlation to verify absence of systematic length variation, (2) length--feature correlation to identify features with moderate length dependence, and (3) classification on length-matched subsets that equalize length distributions across depth classes (\S\ref{sec:results-classification}).

def compute_fdg_logprob(texts, model, tokenizer, device, bs=16):
    import torch
    import torch.nn.functional as F
    fdg, lp = [], []
    for i in range(0, len(texts), bs):
        batch = texts[i:i+bs]
        enc = tokenizer(batch, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True,
                        max_length=MAX_LEN, padding=True).to(device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            logits = model(**enc).logits
        log_p = F.log_softmax(logits[:, :-1], dim=-1)
        tgt = enc["input_ids"][:, 1:]
        mask = enc["attention_mask"][:, 1:].bool()
        actual = log_p.gather(2, tgt.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
        expected = (log_p.exp() * log_p).sum(-1)
        curv = actual - expected
        for j in range(len(batch)):
            m = mask[j]
            if m.sum() < 2:
                fdg.append(0.0); lp.append(0.0); continue
            c = curv[j][m]
            mc, sc = c.mean().item(), c.std().item()
            fdg.append(mc / (sc + 1e-8) if sc > 1e-8 else mc)
            lp.append(actual[j][m].mean().item())
        if (i // bs) % 200 == 0:
            print(f"  FDG+LP: {min(i+bs,len(texts))}/{len(texts)}")
    return fdg, lp

Now I have a clear picture of all the components:

**7-feature ensemble:**
- Models: 1× Pythia-410M (410M params)
- Forward passes per text: 1 (for 5 reference features)
- Surface features: TTR + hapax_ratio (CPU only, no GPU)

**4-det+surface:**
- **Avg-LogProb**: Computed during Pythia-410M forward pass (same pass as FastDetectGPT)
- **FastDetectGPT**: Computed during same Pythia-410M forward pass (conditional probability curvature)


- **Binoculars**: Needs both Pythia-410M and Pythia-1B models with separate forward passes
- **LD-Score**: Character-level trigram divergence using Jensen-Shannon distance—CPU-based string analysis with sparse matrix computation
- **Surface**: TTR + hapax_ratio (CPU)

The evaluation script loads Pythia-410M first to extract FastDetectGPT and Avg-LogProb in a single pass, then handles the additional models and CPU-based metrics.

In total, I'm looking at 3 model forward passes across all detectors: one through Pythia-410M (shared by two detectors) and one through Pythia-1B for Binoculars, while LD-Score and surface features run entirely on CPU without any model inference. they're called sequentially in the code, but the Pythia-410M forward pass could theoretically be cached and reused across both FDG/LogProb and Binoculars. In practice though, the implementation runs it twice—once for the first detector and again when computing Binoculars with the performer model. Writing the benchmark script...

"""Efficiency benchmark: 7-feature ensemble vs 4-det+surface."""
import json, time, gc, os, sys
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

def load_sample_texts(n=N_SAMPLES):
    texts = []
    with open(DATA_DIR / "generations.jsonl") as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f):
            if i >= n:
                break
            texts.append(json.loads(line)["text"])
    return texts


def get_gpu_memory_mb():
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    return torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(DEVICE) / 1024 / 1024


def reset_gpu_stats():
    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(DEVICE)
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    gc.collect()


# ================================================================
# Method 1: 7-feature ensemble
# ================================================================

def benchmark_7feature(texts, tokenizer, model):
    """1× Pythia-410M forward pass → 5 ref features + 2 surface features."""
    reset_gpu_stats()
    
    # Warmup
    for t in texts[:WARMUP]:
        enc = tokenizer([t], return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=MAX_LEN, padding=True).to(DEVICE)
        with torch.no_grad():
            logits = model(**enc).logits
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    reset_gpu_stats()
    
    # Benchmark
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    seq_lens = []
    
    for text in texts:
        enc = tokenizer([text], return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=MAX_LEN, padding=True).to(DEVICE)
        with torch.no_grad():
            logits = model(**enc).logits
        
        mask = enc["attention_mask"][0].bool()
        seq_len = mask.sum().item()
        seq_lens.append(seq_len)
        
        if seq_len < 2:
            continue
        
        token_logits = logits[0, :seq_len - 1, :]
        log_probs = torch.log_softmax(token_logits, dim=-1)
        probs = torch.exp(log_probs)
        entropy = -(probs * log_probs).sum(dim=-1)
        entropy_np = entropy.float().cpu().numpy()
        
        # 5 reference features
        _ = float(np.mean(entropy_np))
        _ = float(np.std(entropy_np))
        _ = float(np.min(entropy_np))
        _ = float(np.max(entropy_np))
        
        avg_lp = log_probs.float().mean(dim=0)
        sorted_lp, _ = torch.sort(avg_lp, descending=True)
        sorted_np = sorted_lp.cpu().numpy()
        V = sorted_np.shape[0]
        hi = min(1000, V)
        lo = min(100, hi)
        if hi - lo >= 2:
            x = np.arange(lo, hi, dtype=np.float64)
            y = sorted_np[lo:hi].astype(np.float64)
            _ = float(np.polyfit(x, y, 1)[0])
        
        # 2 surface features (CPU)
        words = text.lower().split()
        n = len(words)
        if n > 0:
            counter = Counter(words)
            _ = len(counter) / n
            _ = sum(1 for c in counter.values() if c == 1) / n
    
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t0
    peak_mem = get_gpu_memory_mb()
    
    return {
        "total_time_s": round(elapsed, 3),
        "per_text_ms": round(elapsed / len(texts) * 1000, 2),
        "gpu_memory_mb": round(peak_mem, 1),
        "avg_seq_len": round(np.mean(seq_lens), 1),
    }


# ================================================================
# Method 2: 4-det+surface
# ================================================================

def benchmark_4det_surface(texts, tokenizer_410m, model_410m, model_1b):
    """
    Avg-LogProb + FastDetectGPT: 1× Pythia-410M pass
    Binoculars: 1× Pythia-410M + 1× Pythia-1B pass
    LD-Score: CPU trigram JSD
    Surface: CPU TTR + hapax
    """

        with torch.no_grad():
            logits = model_410m(**enc).logits
        
        log_p = F.log_softmax(logits[:, :-1], dim=-1)
        tgt = enc["input_ids"][:, 1:]
        mask = enc["attention_mask"][:, 1:].bool()
        actual = log_p.gather(2, tgt.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
        expected = (log_p.exp() * log_p).sum(-1)

        m = mask[0]

    time_fdg_lp = time.perf_counter() - t0
    mem_after_fdg = get_gpu_memory_mb()

    t1 = time.perf_counter()

        with torch.no_grad():

            p_logits = model_1b(**enc).logits[:, :-1].contiguous()
        
        ids = enc["input_ids"][:, 1:].contiguous()
        mask = enc["attention_mask"][:, 1:].float()
        
        o_ce = F.cross_entropy(o_logits.view(-1, o_logits.size(-1)), ids.view(-1), reduction="none").view(ids.shape)
        p_ce = F.cross_entropy(p_logits.view(-1, p_logits.size(-1)), ids.view(-1), reduction="none").view(ids.shape)
        
        m = mask[0]
        if m.sum() >= 2:
            o_val = (o_ce[0] * m).sum() / m.sum()
            p_val = (p_ce[0] * m).sum() / m.sum()
            _ = (o_val / (p_val + 1e-8)).item()
    
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    time_bino = time.perf_counter() - t1
    mem_after_bino = get_gpu_memory_mb()
    
    # ---- Part C: LD-Score (CPU trigram JSD) ----
    t2 = time.perf_counter()
    
    vocab = {}
    rows_data = []
    for text in texts:
        t_lower = text.lower()
        c = Counter(t_lower[j:j+3] for j in range(len(t_lower) - 2))
        for ng in c:
            if ng not in vocab:

        rows_data.append(c)
    
    V = len(vocab)
    mat = lil_matrix((len(texts), V), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, c in enumerate(rows_data):
        total = sum(c.values())
        if total > 0:
            for ng, cnt in c.items():
                mat[i, vocab[ng]] = cnt / total
    mat_csr = mat.tocsr()
    
    # Compute JSD against mean reference (using first 20% as "reference" for benchmark)
    ref_mask = np.zeros(len(texts), dtype=bool)
    ref_mask[:len(texts)//5] = True
    ref_dist = np.asarray(mat_csr[ref_mask].mean(axis=0)).flatten()
    ref_sum = ref_dist.sum()
    if ref_sum > 0:
        ref_dist /= ref_sum
    
    h_q = -np.sum(ref_dist[ref_dist > 0] * np.log(ref_dist[ref_dist > 0]))
    batch = mat_csr.toarray()
    row_sums = batch.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1
    batch = batch / row_sums
    safe_batch = np.where(batch > 0, batch, 1.0)
    h_p = -np.sum(batch * np.log(safe_batch), axis=1)
    m_dist = (batch + ref_dist[np.newaxis, :]) / 2.0
    safe_m = np.where(m_dist > 0, m_dist, 1.0)
    h_m = -np.sum(m_dist * np.log(safe_m), axis=1)
    jsd_sq = np.clip(h_m - (h_p + h_q) / 2.0, 0, None)
    _ = np.sqrt(jsd_sq)
    
    time_ld = time.perf_counter() - t2
    
    # ---- Part D: Surface features (CPU) ----
    t3 = time.perf_counter()
    for text in texts:
        words = text.lower().split()
        n = len(words)
        if n > 0:
            counter = Counter(words)
            _ = len(counter) / n
            _ = sum(1 for c in counter.values() if c == 1) / n
    time_surface = time.perf_counter() - t3

    return {
        "total_time_s": round(total_time, 3),
        "per_text_ms": round(total_time / len(texts) * 1000, 2),

        "breakdown": {

            "binoculars_s": round(time_bino, 3),
            "ld_score_s": round(time_ld, 3),
            "surface_s": round(time_surface, 3),
        }
    }


# ================================================================

def main():

结果已保存到 `/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/efficiency_comparison.json`。

核心数据：

| Metric | 7-feature | 4-det+surface |
|---|---|---|
| Models | 1× Pythia-410M | Pythia-410M + Pythia-1B |
| Total params | 410M | 1.41B (3.4×) |
| Forward passes/text | 1 | 3 (naive) / 2 (optimized) |
| GPU memory | 905 MB | 2,868 MB (3.2×) |
| Wall-clock | 9.7 ms/text | 22.8 ms/text |
| FLOPs/text | 1.94×10¹¹ | 6.68×10¹¹ (optimized, 3.4×) |
| **Speedup** | — | **2.35× slower** |

时间 breakdown (4-det+surface 的 2.28s/100 texts):
- FDG+LogProb (Pythia-410M pass): 0.858s (37.6%)
- Binoculars (410M+1B double pass): 1.359s (59.6%)
- LD-Score (CPU trigram JSD): 0.061s (2.7%)
- Surface features (CPU): 0.002s (<0.1%)

Binoculars 的双模型 forward pass 占了近 60% 的开销。7-feature ensemble 以单次 410M forward pass 实现了与 4-det+surface 统计不可区分的 binary F1 (0.701 vs 0.707)，但速度快 2.35×、显存省 3.2×。
